prior_catalog_record.title: Pauline Bonaparte as Venus Victrix
prior_catalog_record.scan_source: Photogrammetric model of the physical sculpture, preserved in the openly licensed Objaverse archive. Browser geometry optimized from that exact source. Atrium removed extraneous captured ground or detached scan debris; no missing sculptural surfaces were reconstructed.
prior_catalog_record.note: Pauline Borghese reclines as Venus, holding the apple awarded to the goddess for her beauty. Canova turns an identifiable woman into a mythological victor while retaining the intimacy of a portrait. Her body, cushions and couch are carefully differentiated in marble.
